_comment: Voice roster for bodhan-ai/indic-speak-preview-v2, from the README's 'All 95 voices by language' table -- the authoritative one. voices.md lists only the 44 RECOMMENDED voices (one female, one male per language) and omits Bhili entirely. IMPORTANT: v2 is fully CROSS-LINGUAL -- every voice can speak every language, and the prompt carries NO language code at all, so the model infers language from the script of the text. The mapping below is each voice's native language, which is what keeps speaker names unique and lets an OpenAI client select a language with the standard 'voice' field alone. ENGLISH IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT: the model card lists 44 English voices and they are the same 44 names, so adding them would make every Rasa name ambiguous and break /v1/audio/speech for callers that send only 'voice'. Styles are v2's own trained tags and share nothing with the previous checkpoint's CONV/WIKI/NEWS set.
